resolvedFindings.reason: Both locales now define A as the effective-force integral over displacement relative to the rod, not total magnetic work on the carrier. They explicitly include motion with and within the conductor in total velocity, state that magnetic force does no total work, and identify the mechanical mover as the electrical-energy source. The magnitude relation A=f*l is retained with its source binding and formula unchanged.
resolvedFindings.primaryEvidence: Existing D092 OpenStax rendered-text receipts only, hash-verified; no repeated research
resolvedFindings.independentReasoning: For total carrier velocity u=v+w, q(u cross B) dot u is zero. With w constrained along the rod, the rod-relative component enters the EMF calculation; its magnetic power is canceled by the component associated with motion of the rod in the total-velocity dot product. The new prose no longer attributes electrical energy to magnetic creation of carrier energy.

resolvedFindings.reason: Both locales replace the any-conductor claim with a straight rod in the established geometry, aligned along v cross B and perpendicular to both vectors.
